claims.claim: DeepSeek-R1 beats OpenAI's o1 on the benchmarks AIME, MATH-500, and SWE-bench Verified.
R1 is available from the AI dev platform Hugging Face under an MIT license.
The full R1 requires beefier hardware, but it is available through DeepSeek's API at prices 90%-95% cheaper than OpenAI's o1.
The smallest distilled version of R1 can run on a laptop.
R1 won't answer questions about Tiananmen Square or Taiwan's autonomy.

delta: Released on Hugging Face under MIT license
API availability announced with claimed cost advantage

prior_art.name: Open-source reasoning models with 671 billion parameters
prior_art.differs: No prior open-source model with 671B parameters has been independently confirmed.

prior_art.name: Models with distilled versions from 1.5B to 70B parameters
prior_art.differs: Distillation to 1.5B is notable, but not unprecedented; several models have been distilled to similar sizes.

parsed.tldr: DeepSeek-R1 is released on Hugging Face with 671B parameters and MIT license; claims of beating o1 are unverified, pricing and hardware claims lack evidence.
